company_name: Centre for Semiconductor Technologies (SemiX) IIT Bombay
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The Centre for Semiconductor Technologies (SemiX) at IIT Bombay is involved in advancing semiconductor solutions across various segments of the value chain, but it is primarily an academic and research institution rather than a commercial supplier.
summary: The Centre for Semiconductor Technologies (SemiX) at IIT Bombay focuses on advancing semiconductor solutions by integrating materials, equipment, devices, circuits, packaging, and software. It leverages expertise from initiatives like the Centre of Excellence in Nanoelectronics to foster innovation in semiconductor processes and applications.
capabilities: Integration of semiconductor materials and devices
Development of semiconductor circuits and packaging solutions

regional_presence.India: Based in IIT Bombay, the center focuses on semiconductor research and development within India.
